snippet.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Mysteria Ecclesiae DLC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Darkness has fallen over Sedletz Monastery. Mysteria Ecclesiae, the third story DLC for Kingdom Come: Deliverance II, is OUT NOW.
 
A deadly plague spreads within the monastery walls, and only Henry can uncover its source. Question the brothers, follow the clues, and face the truth hidden in the shadows.
 
Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Mysteria Ecclesiae is available now on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, and as part of the Expansion Pass.
